meta.scope: Union of individual collector/reference pages, marketplace product listings, portals, packs, accessories, and documented scan identities. Internal, debug, digital, and unreleased identity records are kept separate from confirmed retail collectibles.
meta.accuracyPolicy: Facts are copied from named sources. Compatibility is taken from individual collector pages or left unset. Scan links require an exact documented name or alias; fuzzy scan linking is disabled.
